ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels, with dark pigmentation dominating the central and inner-lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity central mass spanning both lobes. High-intensity regions are isolated to the distal tips and the lower leading edge. The left distal tip contains three distinct, low-intensity circular focal spots; the right tip displays smaller, irregular low-intensity clusters near the margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45-50 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged continuous linear boundary featuring frequent, high-amplitude peaks and valleys (5-15 pixels in depth) across the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward and outward trajectory for both lobes, terminating in sharp, irregular distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of high-contrast circular clusters on the light-pigmented left distal tip. Additional irregular, textured pixel clusters localized on the extreme margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left high-intensity zone; faint horizontal linear markings detected in the central-right low-intensity area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular calcified masses (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Multiple circular focal scars are visible on the light-pigmented sections of the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme biological encrustation on the right distal tip creates a highly unique, jagged silhouette profile that deviates from standard geometric lobe curvature.
